conviction_note: Baseline's 1.14% median is contaminated: of the 8 filings it measured, only two (2026-05-29 Q1 at +0.27% and 2026-03-13 FY25 at -6.47%) are actual results releases, so the real earnings-print magnitude for this name is closer to 3%; I take a modest negative because the reported quarter carries a charter-transition idle gap and loses Q1's $4.9m non-recurring insurance income, against a completely flat run-in (5d 0.0%, 20d +0.26%) that prices neither.

findings.finding: The quarter being reported (Q2/H1 2026) contains a multi-week unpaid gap on the Clean Energy - redelivered from SEFE 'in early April 2026' and only delivered to Rio Grande 'at the end of April 2026' per the company's own Q1 release - and it also loses the $4.9m of non-recurring insurance 'Other income' that supplied roughly $0.13 of Q1's $0.43 headline EPS, so the Q2 bar is materially lower than the 'higher daily rate ... accretive' framing that is the only Clean Energy commentary in circulation.
findings.why_not_priced: consensus_eps_forecast is null on one estimate (event.json) and the search trace records WallStreetZen showing a 1Y price target of 'N/A' and no Stifel rating action since 2023, so there is no published number for the quarter to be marked against and no analyst to net the idle days off the higher rate. Every third-party summary in the corpus - the TipRanks headline 'Secures Higher-Rate Charter for Clean Energy', the StockTitan 'LNG shipping rates surge, Dynagas sits on $0.8B in long-term charters' - carries the accretion and drops the ~25 unpaid days and the insurance reversal. If this were priced, a $138m-cap name with 50k shares of daily volume would not be sitting exactly flat over both 5 and 20 days into the print.
findings.independence: The same underlying utilisation decay shows up independently in the FY2025 release, which reports fleet utilisation of 98.8% in Q4 2025 and 100.0% in Q4 2024 against the 95.1% Q1 2026 print, and flags 'the decrease in Revenue earning days of one of our vessels due to unscheduled repairs': https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/DLNG/6-k-dynagas-lng-partners-lp-current-report-foreign-issuer-3546ebeb2ab3.html

findings.finding: The Arctic Aurora - the single vessel that accounted for the Equinor charter, 25% of FY2025 revenue - comes off Equinor and onto its new ~7-year Rio Grande LNG fixture 'commencing between September - November 2026', i.e. inside the current quarter, and the Clean Energy precedent in the same charter package says such a handover costs roughly three to four weeks of unpaid hire; this print is where that timetable gets set.
findings.corpus_ref: snapshots/20260904T154434Z.json item 5; body at docs/2f55a33d0047c5903f3e135afdcc25a7a0443648.txt (datePublished 2023-07-14, three years old - checked, the September-November 2026 window is a forward date inside a 2023 document, not a 2026 story)
findings.why_not_priced: The Sept-Nov 2026 commencement window is buried in a July 2023 press release; neither of the two most recent company releases in the corpus mentions the Arctic Aurora transition at all - both discuss only the Clean Energy - and the Arctic Aurora is the vessel whose lower rate the company itself blamed for the adjusted-income decline in Q4 2025 and again in Q1 2026. With one estimate and no price target on the name there is nobody modelling a Q3/Q4 off-hire window on 17% of the fleet. If it were priced the stock would not be flat over 20 days with the transition month already underway.
findings.independence: The revenue weight comes from a different document: the FY2025 20-F, whose charterer concentration is recorded as SEFE 40% / Yamal 35% / Equinor 25% - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578453/000110465926040882/dlng-20251231x20f.htm (search_trace/20260904T154434Z.json, area 5). The Arctic Aurora's $125.2m sale-and-leaseback balance, the largest of the four, is in the Q1 6-K.

findings.finding: Dynagas restated its own results date twice inside two days - GlobeNewswire 2026-09-01 said after the close on Monday September 7 (a US market holiday), GlobeNewswire 2026-09-02 corrected it to before the open on Tuesday September 8 - and the results 6-K was in fact only accepted at 2026-09-09 05:24 ET, a further day late.
findings.corpus_ref: search_trace/20260904T154434Z.json area 1 (both press releases are in snapshots/20260904T154434Z.json 'skipped' with fetch failures, so headline+URL+trace snippet only); acceptance time from seal.json accession 0001317861-26-000046
findings.why_not_priced: The two conflicting date announcements were tiny wire items on a nano-cap and the third slip is visible only by comparing the corrected release against the filing's actual acceptance stamp - nothing aggregates that. A results date that moves three times in a partnership whose 36%-of-revenue charterer faces a January 1 2027 legal cliff, and which has told the market that disagreement 'could result in disputes, nonperformance, litigation, or early termination', is a weak but real friction tell. Marked small and wide because I cannot read either press release body and cannot rule out a third, uncaptured announcement that made September 9 public before the print.

searched_and_found_nothing: any insider Form 4 activity by DLNG officers or directors in the 400-day filing window - the only ownership filings are seven Form 3 initial statements clustered in March 2026 and a Schedule 13G on 2026-08-13, with no Form 4 purchases or sales at all
any equity or debt issuance shelf take-down: no F-3 amendment, no 424B, no 6-K carrying a financing, in a window where the F-3 (333-281195) is live and incorporated by reference into every 6-K
any change in the $0.050 common distribution - it was declared flat on 2026-08-13 before the print, so the distribution line is already known and priced

an actual dated confirmation of the reported EU/Greek sanctions exemption: the kyivindependent body is stored but its lines are unreadable as captured, and the indexbox 'Greece Blocks EU Sanctions on Russian LNG: Dynagas Interests Cited' item is search-trace headline only with no date, so I could not establish whether a positive sanctions development landed before the print
the Q2 2025 comparable quarter - no Q2 2025 press release or 10-Q equivalent is in the corpus, so I could only bracket Q2 2025 EPS from the FY2025 total minus Q1 and Q4
any new charter, vessel sale or acquisition since the Q1 print
any buyback execution: the $10m program renewed 2025-11-24 bought nothing in Q1 2026 (Repurchase of common units: nil in the Q1 cash flow statement)
baseline_tension: It cuts against the flat run-in rather than agreeing with it: the tape has priced nothing in either direction over 20 days, while the corpus says the reported quarter loses both the Clean Energy's April hire days and Q1's one-off insurance income, and it cuts against the baseline's own 1.14% median, which is built from monthly distribution 6-Ks rather than results releases and understates how far this name moves on an actual print.
